record.paper_title: Hénon maps: a list of open problems
record.original_question: For the real quadratic Hénon maps f_{c,b}(x,y)=(x^2+c-by,x), which maps are mildly dissipative? In particular, is every map with |b|<1 mildly dissipative?

evidence.quote: Question 6. — Which real Hénon maps fc,b are mildly dissipative? Is this property satisfied by all Hénon maps with |b| < 1?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For real parameters $c \in \mathbb{R}$ and $b \in \mathbb{R}\setminus\{0\}$, consider the real quadratic Hénon diffeomorphism
$$f_{c,b}:\mathbb{R}^2\to\mathbb{R}^2,\qquad f_{c,b}(x,y)=(x^2+c-by,\;x).$$
A $C^1$ diffeomorphism $f$ of a surface is called mildly dissipative if it is dissipative (so that $|\det Df|<1$ everywhere; equivalently for Hénon maps, $|b|<1$) and if, for every ergodic $f$-invariant Borel probability measure $\mu$ that is not supported on a periodic sink, and for $\mu$-almost every point $p$, each of the two connected components of $W^s(p)\setminus\{p\}$ in the stable manifold of $p$ is unbounded in $\mathbb{R}^2$.

(a) Characterize the pairs $(c,b)\in\mathbb{R}^2$ with $0<|b|<1$ for which the Hénon map $f_{c,b}$ is mildly dissipative.

(b) In particular, decide whether every real Hénon map $f_{c,b}$ with $0<|b|<1$ is mildly dissipative.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in the list of open problems on Hénon maps. Crovisier and Pujals introduced mild dissipation and established it for dissipative surface diffeomorphisms with sufficiently small Jacobian (in particular for Hénon maps with $|b|<1/4$, or under stronger "strong dissipation" hypotheses), but a characterization of the full mildly dissipative locus in parameter space, and in particular whether every Hénon map with $|b|<1$ is mildly dissipative, does not appear to be resolved in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Mildly dissipative diffeomorphisms of the disk with zero entropy
status_evidence.snippet: Crovisier and Pujals study mildly dissipative diffeomorphisms; mild dissipation is established for Hénon maps with sufficiently small Jacobian.
status_evidence.claim: Mild dissipation is known for small-Jacobian Hénon maps, but a full characterization for |b|<1 is not provided.

status_evidence.title: Strongly dissipative surface diffeomorphisms (Crovisier-Pujals)
status_evidence.snippet: Strongly dissipative case treated; mild dissipation in full generality remains beyond the scope.
status_evidence.claim: Existing results cover strong/small-Jacobian dissipation, not the entire range |b|<1.
